findings: BRIDGES 1/24 sentences (4%) connect to the one before. The approved iPhone 18 Pro script runs 53%; the weak generation of the same story ran 9%. A sentence that starts a new subject with no bridge reads as the next bullet, not the next beat. (framework S9, S22)
WHAT WITHOUT SO WHAT 1/1 spec sentences never say what the number does for the viewer. "2nm chip" is information; "faster without draining the battery" is relevance. (framework S7)
